en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small rural wooden building with a tiled roof and decorative trim, likely a village post office or shop, with a fenced yard and two white wooden gates in front. A few people stand in the doorway. Large leafy trees frame the scene, and a simple monument or utility box stands by the unpaved road. The architecture and lettering suggest a Scandinavian countryside setting. Text is printed in white in the lower left and lower right corners.
